name: Mortal Kombat X — Story Mode
notes: Primary in-game Mortal Kombat X Story Mode footage accessed through a third-party gameplay upload; the uploader is preservation/access infrastructure rather than canonical authority. Chapter 1 shows Netherrealm forces attacking Earthrealm, Raiden and Fujin defending the Sky Temple/Jinsei, Shinnok confronting them, Johnny Cage manifesting green defensive power when Shinnok attacks Sonya, and Raiden imprisoning Shinnok in his own amulet. The early post-imprisonment sequence then shows Earthrealm forces confront Quan Chi in the Netherrealm, Quan Chi begin a revenant-creation spell on a mortally wounded Johnny, Raiden counter the spell, Sonya defeat Quan Chi when he interferes, and Raiden complete the reversal that saves Johnny and restores Jax, Scorpion/Hanzo Hasashi, and Sub-Zero/Kuai Liang. Twenty years later, Johnny briefs Cassie Cage, Jacqui Briggs, Takeda Takahashi, and Kung Jin, assigns them to contact Sub-Zero, and the ensuing Lin Kuei mission is revealed as a training exercise arranged with Sub-Zero to test the squad's teamwork. Back at the Earthrealm refugee camp, Li Mei reports Mileena's rebels wielding a destructive gold talisman; Raiden suspects it may be Shinnok's amulet but leaves to verify, while Sonya sends Cassie's squad to Outworld to confirm Li Mei's report with Kotal Kahn. In Chapter 4, Cassie's squad reaches Outworld's capital, is brought before Kotal Kahn, faces his accusation that they may be allied with Mileena, and avoids execution when Kung Jin invokes the right of defense, defeats Kotal in kombat, and secures a cooperation arrangement against Mileena. After the Kotal/Kung Jin cooperation agreement, Sonya relays Mileena's location to Cassie, Kotal prepares an operation against the rebel camp, Cassie and D'Vorah infiltrate it, the destructive talisman is directly identified as Shinnok's amulet, and D'Vorah physically recovers the amulet from its container.
